Class DefaultSchema.DefaultSchemaProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.schemas.annotations.DefaultSchema.DefaultSchemaProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public static class DefaultSchema.DefaultSchemaProvider extends Object implements SchemaProvider
SchemaProvider for default schemas. Looks up the provider annotated for a type, and delegates to that provider.
